data.title: Unit 12: The solar system
The sun and the planets
data.text: All the planets that revolve around the Sun along with their moons, form the solar system.
Planets and moons don't have light of their own.
Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are known as terrestrial planets as they are solid.
Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are called gas planets as they are made up of gases.
There is an asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
Pluto was considered to be the ninth planet of the solar system. Now it is referred to as a dwarf planet.
